audit_status.source_base: Greek Romans text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for living sacrifice, transformed mind, body gifts, sincere love, blessing enemies, overcoming harm with good.

verses.restored: Therefore I urge you, siblings, through the mercies of the Divine, to present your bodies as living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to the Divine, your reasonable/spiritual service.

familiar.text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

verses.restored: And do not be conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewal of the mind, so that you may discern what is the will of the Divine: the good, pleasing, and complete.

familiar.text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

verses.restored: For through the grace given to me I say to everyone among you not to think beyond what one ought to think, but to think into sober-mindedness, as the Divine apportioned to each a measure of trust.

familiar.text: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

verses.restored: For just as in one body we have many members, and all the members do not have the same practice,

familiar.text: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

verses.restored: so we, the many, are one body in Messiah, and individually members of one another.

familiar.text: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

verses.restored: Having gifts differing according to the grace given to us: if prophecy, according to the proportion of trust;

familiar.text: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

verses.restored: if service, in the service; if the one teaching, in the teaching;

familiar.text: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

verses.restored: if the one encouraging, in encouragement; the one sharing, in simplicity/generosity; the one leading, in diligence; the one showing mercy, in cheerfulness.

familiar.text: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

verses.restored: Let love be unhypocritical; detest the harmful; cling to the good.

familiar.text: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

verses.restored: In sibling-love be devoted to one another; in honor, leading the way for one another;

familiar.text: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

verses.restored: in diligence, not shrinking; in spirit, boiling; serving the Lord;

familiar.text: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

verses.restored: rejoicing in hope, enduring in pressure, persevering in prayer;

familiar.text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

verses.restored: sharing in the needs of the holy ones; pursuing hospitality.

familiar.text: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

verses.restored: Bless those pursuing you; bless and do not curse.

familiar.text: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

verses.restored: Rejoice with those rejoicing; weep with those weeping.

familiar.text: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

verses.restored: Think the same toward one another; do not think high things, but be carried with the lowly. Do not become wise in yourselves.

familiar.text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

verses.restored: Repay no one harm for harm; give thought beforehand to beautiful/good things before all humans.

familiar.text: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

verses.restored: If possible, as far as it depends on you, live in peace with all humans.

familiar.text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

verses.restored: Beloved, do not avenge yourselves, but give place to wrath; for it is written: Vengeance is mine, I will repay, says the Lord.

familiar.text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

verses.restored: But if your enemy hungers, feed that one; if thirsty, give drink; for doing this you will heap coals of fire upon that one's head.

familiar.text: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

verses.restored: Do not be conquered by harm, but conquer harm with good.

familiar.text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

translation_notes: Bodies are presented positively as living sacrifice; this is embodied worship, not body-denial.
Romans 12 moves from doctrine to embodied communal practice: gifts, hospitality, empathy, enemy-love, and non-retaliation.
